<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Runs user-defined shell commands in any external plugin phase supported by SemRel: `condition`, `generator`, `pre-tag`, and `release`. Use it to call build scripts, custom validations, or deployment commands without writing a dedicated plugin.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/hook-exec
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/hook-exec:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/hook-exec:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/hook-exec/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/hook-exec
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      cmd: ./scripts/build.sh
      timeout: 10m
      env: |
        BUILD_MODE: release
```

SemRel maps every `args` value to a single environment variable, so structured values such as `env` must be passed as a YAML or JSON string.

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CMD` | no | `—` | Command to run in the configured phase. Required unless a lifecycle-keyed command is set. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_SHELL` | no | `sh` | Shell executable. Defaults to `cmd` on Windows. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CWD` | no | repository root | Working directory of the child process. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_ENV` | no | `—` | YAML or JSON string map merged into the child environment. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_TIMEOUT` | no | `5m` | Go duration such as `30s` or `10m`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_RUN_IN_DRY_RUN` | no | `false` | Execute the command even when `SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PHASE` | no | inferred | Explicit phase for lifecycle-keyed commands. |

## Lifecycle-keyed commands

For compatibility with `@semantic-release/exec` terminology, these keys can replace `cmd`:

| Argument | SemRel phase | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `verifyConditionsCmd` | `condition` | Gates the release. |
| `generateNotesCmd` | `generator` | Stdout becomes `SEMREL_CHANGELOG`; diagnostics belong on stderr. |
| `verifyReleaseCmd` | `pre-tag` | Runs before `prepareCmd`. |
| `prepareCmd` | `pre-tag` | Prepares build output or generated files. |
| `publishCmd` | `release` | Runs before `successCmd`. |
| `successCmd` | `release` | Post-publish success action. |

Set `phase` when the configuration contains commands for more than one phase. If exactly one phase group is present, hook-exec infers it. SemRel has no external `analyzer` phase and does not invoke plugins after a failed pipeline, so `analyzeCommitsCmd` and `failCmd` are rejected with an explicit error instead of being silently ignored.

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_CURRENT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_TAG_NAME`
- `SEMREL_BRANCH`
- `SEMREL_BUMP`
- `SEMREL_CHANGELOG`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

Commands also support standalone `${nextRelease.version}`, `${lastRelease.version}`, `${gitTag}`, `${tag}`, `${channel}`, `${branch}`, and `${date}` placeholders. Inserted values are shell-quoted, so do not wrap a placeholder in additional quotes.

## Behavior

POSIX shells are invoked with `-c`, PowerShell with `-NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command`, and `cmd.exe` with `/D /S /C`. Non-zero exit codes and timeouts fail the plugin; on Unix a timeout terminates the whole shell process group. When `SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`, commands are logged and skipped unless `runInDryRun` is enabled.

## Security

hook-exec intentionally executes trusted repository configuration with the permissions of the SemRel process. Review command changes as carefully as CI workflow changes.

- Never concatenate commit messages, changelog content, contributor data, or branch names into a command.
- Consume release context through quoted environment variables inside a script.
- Keep secrets out of `.semrel.yaml` and provide them through the CI environment.
- Use a minimal shell, an explicit working directory, and a finite timeout.
